about.title: About us
about.lead: Velvet Talents is a company specialising in textile coverings for the automotive, footwear and upholstery industries.
paragraphs: Building on solid know-how, Velvet Talents has joined forces with its international partners and suppliers to offer customers excellent value for money.
Founded in 2010, the company has an ambitious vision for the future and keeps investing in innovation, by modernising its processes and developing new products.
values: Respect and commitment to our customers
about.valuesText: These are the values the company stands for.

coverings.title: Lamination
coverings.subtitle: Foam lamination of fabrics
paragraphs: One of Velvet Talents' specialities is laminating materials with foam for the automotive and footwear industries.
We use flame lamination, a process that can bond foam to any material.
No glue of any kind is used: the surface of the foam is melted and used to bond the material.

howToOrder.title: How to request a quote?

steps.title: Request a quote
steps.text: You can request a quote using the form on every Velvet Talents product page, by email or by phone.

steps.title: Confirm your order
steps.text: To place an order, contact us by phone or email. If you send your order by email without a quote, we will contact you to confirm the price and your details.

steps.title: Collect or receive
steps.text: You are welcome to collect the material in person at our warehouse. If it needs to be shipped, you can pay cash on delivery or by bank transfer. Shipping costs are charged to the customer.

howToOrder.resale: For resale orders, please contact us directly by phone, as these are handled case by case.
